notes.subject: אלם
notes.rationale: 'Silence': read as 'in silence' (ASV), 'O congregation' (KJV, repointing to אֵלִם 'gods/rulers'), or 'O dumb one' (YLT).

notes.subject: בני אדם
notes.rationale: 'Sons of Adam-kind' — rendered as one word 'adamadenw', humans/rulers addressed.

notes.subject: aw
notes.rationale: Direct reproachful address to the judges/rulers of the land.

notes.subject: tiɲɛ na wa
notes.rationale: Rhetorical questions draw the addressee (and hearer) into the accusation.

translation: Tiɲɛ na wa, sukunyali kɔnɔ aw bɛ tiɲɛ-ɲɛmɔgɔya kuma? Tuwalenya la wa aw bɛ adamadenw ka fɔlilen ɲɛjɔ?
